mechanisms.name: decorrelated movement of Shockley partial dislocations

evidence.quote: Observations of in situ dynamic sequences performed in a transmission electron microscope on several industrial superalloys have shown the occurrence of decorrelated movements of Shockley partial dislocations, originating from perfect dislocation dissociation.
